title: vibe-loop-git v0.2 — Judge Mapping (Auto-Mirror + Tiered Calibration)
rationale: Per Loop 1 OSINT (mem0/mastra/RouteLLM tier-1 sources) + operator pivot row 2486, drift_judge must reuse the harness's primary LLM as its own judge. NO new API keys, NO new endpoints, NO operator onboarding. Tier selection follows Anthropic's 'routing easy → cheap, hard → capable' pattern (Building Effective Agents, Dec 2024). Calibration rules derive from MT-Bench bias analysis.

position_swap.rationale: MT-Bench §3: position bias is strong in smaller judges; for >=medium we run both orderings and require agreement

reference_baseline.rationale: When primary judge returns low confidence, escalate one tier to a more capable model to re-judge with a known-good reference in the prompt

voting.rationale: Multi-agent / large artifacts benefit from ensemble; conf = modal probability across N samples

length_bias_mitigation.prompt_clause: Disregard response length; judge by correctness, completeness, and consistency only.
length_bias_mitigation.rationale: MT-Bench §3: verbosity bias is universal; explicit prompt clause significantly reduces it

thinking_block_stripping.rationale: 2026 reasoning models (MiniMax-M3, DeepSeek-R1, Claude extended thinking) emit <think>...</think> before canonical answer; T-406 implements this in nli/chat.go::parseCanonicalLabel

failure_mode_mitigations.position_bias: swap artifact ordering; verdict requires both orderings agree (for >=medium tier)
failure_mode_mitigations.verbosity_bias: length-disregard prompt clause applied to every NLI prompt
failure_mode_mitigations.self_enhancement_bias: DOCUMENTED LIMITATION — auto-mirror uses same family as artifact author; opt for cross_family_judge operator override to avoid (uses a different provider from author_family)
failure_mode_mitigations.sycophantic_judge: system prompt includes 'You are an honest evaluator, not a yes-man; reject artifacts that fail the criterion'
failure_mode_mitigations.reasoning_truncation: max_tokens=256 + thinking-block stripping (T-406 fix); if model still truncates, escalate tier

force_tier.rationale: operator may force a tier regardless of vibe_case/size rules

force_provider.rationale: operator may force cross-family judge to mitigate self-enhancement bias

cross_family_judge.rationale: always = always use a different provider than the artifact author; never = always same provider; auto = let tier_selection_rules decide

voting_sample_count.rationale: operator may increase N for higher-stakes drift_judge

evidence.claim: GPT-4 80%+ agreement with human preferences; identified biases: position, verbosity, self-enhancement. Mitigation: swap positions + reference-based calibration. NeurIPS 2023 Datasets and Benchmarks Track.
Layered ensemble (6 layers × 6 agents) achieves 65.1% on AlpacaEval 2.0 vs GPT-4 Omni 57.5%; aggregated ensemble > single model.

Tier-1 vendor pattern guide. Routing: 'Routing easy/common questions to smaller, cost-efficient models like Claude Haiku 4.5 and hard/unusual questions to more capable models like Claude Sonnet 4.5.' Parallelization: sectioning + voting. Evaluator-optimizer: generate → evaluate → refine loop.
EMNLP 2024 survey confirms LLM-judge is the SOTA scalable evaluation method for data annotation/synthesis tasks.
Hybrid reasoning model; extended thinking up to 64K tokens. Confirms T-406 insight that 2026 reasoning models emit <think>...</think> before canonical answer.
Operator's correction: NLI = LLMJudge auto-mirror. NO new API keys, NO new endpoints. User segmentation via prefix. ZERO-CONFIG pre-configuration is mandatory per operator profile.

consumed_by: Loop 3 (C7 Multi-Agent Sub-routing) — uses tier_selection_rules.by_vibe_case + voting
Loop 4 (Cold-Start Bootstrap) — uses model_per_provider.minimax.minimax-M3 as default
Loop 5 (Latency Axis) — uses tier cost/latency mapping
Loop 6 (Self-Evaluation) — uses evidence array + failure_mode_mitigations for self-check
